name: HTTP session identifier cookie
description: A cookie whose value is a session identifier the server uses to look up authenticated state (RFC 6265 section 8.4); cookie names and value formats are application-defined, so only the session-identifier role, not a name or a length, makes it a credential.

blockers.summary: No standard names which cookies are session identifiers; the name-to-role mapping is application-defined and stays unresolved.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
